name: APPEND
summary: Appends a string to the value of a key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: DECR
summary: Decrements the integer value of a key by one.

name: DECRBY
summary: Decrements a number from the integer value of a key.

name: GET
summary: Returns the string value of a key.

name: GETDEL
summary: Returns the string value of a key after deleting the key.

name: GETEX
summary: Returns the string value of a key after setting its expiration time.
syntax: GETEX key [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | PERSIST]

name: GETRANGE
summary: Returns a substring of the string stored at a key.
complexity: O(N) where N is the length of the returned string

name: GETSET
summary: Returns the previous string value of a key after setting it to a new value.

name: INCR
summary: Increments the integer value of a key by one.

name: INCRBY
summary: Increments the integer value of a key by a number.

name: INCRBYFLOAT
summary: Increment the floating point value of a key by a number.

name: LCS
summary: Finds the longest common substring.

name: MGET
summary: Atomically returns the string values of one or more keys.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys to retrieve

name: MSET
summary: Atomically creates or modifies the string values of one or more keys.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys to set

name: MSETNX
summary: Atomically modifies the string values of one or more keys only when all keys don't exist.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys to set

name: PSETEX
summary: Sets both string value and expiration time in milliseconds of a key.

name: SET
summary: Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
syntax: SET key value [NX | XX] [GET] [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]

name: SETEX
summary: Sets the string value and expiration time of a key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: SETNX
summary: Set the string value of a key only when the key doesn't exist.

name: SETRANGE
summary: Overwrites a part of a string value with another by an offset. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
complexity: O(1), not counting the time taken to copy the new string in place

name: STRLEN
summary: Returns the length of a string value.

name: SUBSTR
summary: Returns a substring from a string value (deprecated: use GETRANGE).
complexity: O(N) where N is the length of the returned string

name: COPY
summary: Copies the value of a key to a new key.

name: DEL
summary: Deletes one or more keys.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys that will be removed

name: DUMP
summary: Returns a serialized representation of the value stored at a key.
complexity: O(1) to access the key and additional O(N*M) to serialize it

name: EXISTS
summary: Determines whether one or more keys exist.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys to check

name: EXPIRE
summary: Sets the expiration time of a key in seconds.
syntax: EXPIRE key seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]

name: EXPIREAT
summary: Sets the expiration time of a key to a Unix timestamp.
syntax: EXPIREAT key unix-time-seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]

name: EXPIRETIME
summary: Returns the expiration time of a key as a Unix timestamp.

name: KEYS
summary: Returns all key names that match a pattern. Blocks the server on large databases: prefer SCAN.
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of keys in the database

name: MIGRATE
summary: Atomically transfers a key from one Redis instance to another.
syntax: MIGRATE host port <key | ""> destination-db timeout [COPY] [REPLACE] [AUTH password | AUTH2 username password] [KEYS key [key ...]]

name: MOVE
summary: Moves a key to another database.

name: OBJECT ENCODING
summary: Returns the internal encoding of a Redis object.

name: OBJECT FREQ
summary: Returns the logarithmic access frequency counter of a Redis object.

name: OBJECT IDLETIME
summary: Returns the time since the last access to a Redis object.

name: OBJECT REFCOUNT
summary: Returns the reference count of a value of a key.

name: PERSIST
summary: Removes the expiration time of a key.

name: PEXPIRE
summary: Sets the expiration time of a key in milliseconds.
syntax: PEXPIRE key milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]

name: PEXPIREAT
summary: Sets the expiration time of a key to a Unix milliseconds timestamp.
syntax: PEXPIREAT key unix-time-milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]

name: PEXPIRETIME
summary: Returns the expiration time of a key as a Unix milliseconds timestamp.

name: PTTL
summary: Returns the expiration time in milliseconds of a key.

name: RANDOMKEY
summary: Returns a random key name from the database.

name: RENAME
summary: Renames a key and overwrites the destination.

name: RENAMENX
summary: Renames a key only when the target key name doesn't exist.

name: RESTORE
summary: Creates a key from the serialized representation of a value.
syntax: RESTORE key ttl serialized-value [REPLACE] [ABSTTL] [IDLETIME seconds] [FREQ frequency]
complexity: O(1) to create the new key and additional O(N*M) to reconstruct the serialized value

name: SCAN
summary: Iterates over the key names in the database.
complexity: O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration

name: SORT
summary: Sorts the elements in a list, a set, or a sorted set, optionally storing the result.
syntax: SORT key [BY pattern] [LIMIT offset count] [GET pattern [GET pattern ...]] [ASC | DESC] [ALPHA] [STORE destination]

name: SORT_RO
summary: Returns the sorted elements of a list, a set, or a sorted set.
syntax: SORT_RO key [BY pattern] [LIMIT offset count] [GET pattern [GET pattern ...]] [ASC | DESC] [ALPHA]

name: TOUCH
summary: Returns the number of existing keys out of those specified after updating the time they were last accessed.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys that will be touched

name: TTL
summary: Returns the expiration time in seconds of a key.

name: TYPE
summary: Determines the type of value stored at a key.

name: UNLINK
summary: Asynchronously deletes one or more keys.
complexity: O(1) for each key removed regardless of its size

name: WAIT
summary: Blocks until the asynchronous replication of all preceding write commands sent by the connection is completed.

name: HDEL
summary: Deletes one or more fields and their values from a hash. Deletes the hash if no fields remain.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of fields to be removed

name: HEXISTS
summary: Determines whether a field exists in a hash.

name: HEXPIRE
summary: Set expiry for hash field using relative time to expire (seconds).
syntax: HEXPIRE key seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT] FIELDS numfields field [field ...]
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

name: HGET
summary: Returns the value of a field in a hash.

name: HGETALL
summary: Returns all fields and values in a hash.
complexity: O(N) where N is the size of the hash

name: HINCRBY
summary: Increments the integer value of a field in a hash by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the field doesn't exist.

name: HINCRBYFLOAT
summary: Increments the floating point value of a field by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the field doesn't exist.

name: HKEYS
summary: Returns all fields in a hash.
complexity: O(N) where N is the size of the hash

name: HLEN
summary: Returns the number of fields in a hash.

name: HMGET
summary: Returns the values of all fields in a hash.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of fields being requested

name: HMSET
summary: Sets the values of multiple fields (deprecated: use HSET).
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of fields being set

name: HPERSIST
summary: Removes the expiration time for each specified field.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

name: HRANDFIELD
summary: Returns one or more random fields from a hash.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of fields returned

name: HSCAN
summary: Iterates over fields and values of a hash.
complexity: O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration

name: HSET
summary: Creates or modifies the value of a field in a hash.
complexity: O(1) for each field/value pair added

name: HSETNX
summary: Sets the value of a field in a hash only when the field doesn't exist.

name: HSTRLEN
summary: Returns the length of the value of a field.

name: HTTL
summary: Returns the TTL in seconds of a hash field.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

name: HVALS
summary: Returns all values in a hash.
complexity: O(N) where N is the size of the hash

name: BLMOVE
summary: Pops an element from a list, pushes it to another list and returns it. Blocks until an element is available otherwise.
syntax: BLMOVE source destination <LEFT | RIGHT> <LEFT | RIGHT> timeout

name: BLMPOP
summary: Pops the first element from one of multiple lists. Blocks until an element is available otherwise.
syntax: BLMPOP timeout numkeys key [key ...] <LEFT | RIGHT> [COUNT count]

name: BLPOP
summary: Removes and returns the first element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of provided keys

name: BRPOP
summary: Removes and returns the last element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of provided keys

name: BRPOPLPUSH
summary: Pops an element from a list, pushes it to another list and returns it (deprecated: use BLMOVE).

name: LINDEX
summary: Returns an element from a list by its index.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements to traverse

name: LINSERT
summary: Inserts an element before or after another element in a list.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements to traverse

name: LLEN
summary: Returns the length of a list.

name: LMOVE
summary: Returns an element after popping it from one list and pushing it to another.

name: LMPOP
summary: Returns multiple elements from a list after removing them.

name: LPOP
summary: Returns the first elements in a list after removing it.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements returned

name: LPOS
summary: Returns the index of matching elements in a list.
syntax: LPOS key element [RANK rank] [COUNT num-matches] [MAXLEN len]
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements in the list

name: LPUSH
summary: Prepends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: LPUSHX
summary: Prepends one or more elements to a list only when the list exists.

name: LRANGE
summary: Returns a range of elements from a list.

name: LREM
summary: Removes elements from a list. Deletes the list if the last element was removed.

name: LSET
summary: Sets the value of an element in a list by its index.
complexity: O(N) where N is the length of the list

name: LTRIM
summary: Removes elements from both ends a list. Deletes the list if all elements were trimmed.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements to be removed

name: RPOP
summary: Returns and removes the last elements of a list.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements returned

name: RPOPLPUSH
summary: Returns the last element of a list after removing and pushing it to another list (deprecated: use LMOVE).

name: RPUSH
summary: Appends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: RPUSHX
summary: Appends an element to a list only when the list exists.

name: SADD
summary: Adds one or more members to a set. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: SCARD
summary: Returns the number of members in a set.

name: SDIFF
summary: Returns the difference of multiple sets.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets

name: SDIFFSTORE
summary: Stores the difference of multiple sets in a key.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets

name: SINTER
summary: Returns the intersect of multiple sets.

name: SINTERCARD
summary: Returns the number of members of the intersect of multiple sets.

name: SINTERSTORE
summary: Stores the intersect of multiple sets in a key.

name: SISMEMBER
summary: Determines whether a member belongs to a set.

name: SMEMBERS
summary: Returns all members of a set.
complexity: O(N) where N is the set cardinality

name: SMISMEMBER
summary: Determines whether multiple members belong to a set.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of elements being checked

name: SMOVE
summary: Moves a member from one set to another.

name: SPOP
summary: Returns one or more random members from a set after removing them. Deletes the set if the last member was popped.
complexity: Without the count argument O(1), otherwise O(N)

name: SRANDMEMBER
summary: Get one or multiple random members from a set.
complexity: Without the count argument O(1), otherwise O(N)

name: SREM
summary: Removes one or more members from a set. Deletes the set if the last member was removed.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of members to be removed

name: SSCAN
summary: Iterates over members of a set.
complexity: O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration

name: SUNION
summary: Returns the union of multiple sets.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets

name: SUNIONSTORE
summary: Stores the union of multiple sets in a key.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets

name: BZPOPMAX
summary: Removes and returns the member with the highest score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member is available otherwise.

name: BZPOPMIN
summary: Removes and returns the member with the lowest score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member is available otherwise.

name: ZADD
summary: Adds one or more members to a sorted set, or updates their scores. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
syntax: ZADD key [NX | XX] [GT | LT] [CH] [INCR] score member [score member ...]

name: ZCARD
summary: Returns the number of members in a sorted set.

name: ZCOUNT
summary: Returns the count of members in a sorted set that have scores within a range.

name: ZDIFF
summary: Returns the difference between multiple sorted sets.

name: ZINCRBY
summary: Increments the score of a member in a sorted set.

name: ZINTER
summary: Returns the intersect of multiple sorted sets.
syntax: ZINTER numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX>] [WITHSCORES]

name: ZLEXCOUNT
summary: Returns the number of members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range.

name: ZMPOP
summary: Returns the highest- or lowest-scoring members from one or more sorted sets after removing them.

name: ZMSCORE
summary: Returns the score of one or more members in a sorted set.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of members being requested

name: ZPOPMAX
summary: Returns the highest-scoring members from a sorted set after removing them.

name: ZPOPMIN
summary: Returns the lowest-scoring members from a sorted set after removing them.

name: ZRANDMEMBER
summary: Returns one or more random members from a sorted set.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of members returned

name: ZRANGE
summary: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of indexes, scores or lexicographical order.
syntax: ZRANGE key start stop [BYSCORE | BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset count] [WITHSCORES]

name: ZRANGEBYSCORE
summary: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of scores.
syntax: ZRANGEBYSCORE key min max [WITHSCORES] [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZRANGESTORE
summary: Stores a range of members from sorted set in a key.
syntax: ZRANGESTORE dst src min max [BYSCORE | BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZRANK
summary: Returns the index of a member in a sorted set ordered by ascending scores.

name: ZREM
summary: Removes one or more members from a sorted set. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.

name: ZREMRANGEBYRANK
summary: Removes members in a sorted set within a range of indexes.

name: ZREMRANGEBYSCORE
summary: Removes members in a sorted set within a range of scores.

name: ZREVRANGE
summary: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of indexes in reverse order.

name: ZREVRANK
summary: Returns the index of a member in a sorted set ordered by descending scores.

name: ZSCAN
summary: Iterates over members and scores of a sorted set.
complexity: O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration

name: ZSCORE
summary: Returns the score of a member in a sorted set.

name: ZUNION
summary: Returns the union of multiple sorted sets.
syntax: ZUNION numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX>] [WITHSCORES]

name: ZUNIONSTORE
summary: Stores the union of multiple sorted sets in a key.
syntax: ZUNIONSTORE destination numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX>]

name: XACK
summary: Returns the number of messages that were successfully acknowledged by the consumer group member of a stream.
complexity: O(1) for each message ID processed

name: XADD
summary: Appends a new message to a stream. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
syntax: XADD key [NOMKSTREAM] [<MAXLEN | MINID> [= | ~] threshold [LIMIT count]] <* | id> field value [field value ...]
complexity: O(1) when adding a new entry

name: XAUTOCLAIM
summary: Changes, or acquires, ownership of messages in a consumer group, as if the messages were delivered to as consumer group member.
syntax: XAUTOCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time start [COUNT count] [JUSTID]

name: XCLAIM
summary: Changes, or acquires, ownership of a message in a consumer group, as if the message was delivered a consumer group member.
syntax: XCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time id [id ...] [IDLE ms] [TIME unix-time-milliseconds] [RETRYCOUNT count] [FORCE] [JUSTID] [LASTID lastid]
complexity: O(log N) with N being the number of messages in the PEL

name: XDEL
summary: Returns the number of messages after removing them from a stream.
complexity: O(1) for each single item to delete in the stream

name: XGROUP CREATE
summary: Creates a consumer group.

name: XGROUP CREATECONSUMER
summary: Creates a consumer in a consumer group.

name: XGROUP DELCONSUMER
summary: Deletes a consumer from a consumer group.

name: XGROUP DESTROY
summary: Destroys a consumer group.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of entries in the group's pending entries list (PEL)

name: XGROUP SETID
summary: Sets the last-delivered ID of a consumer group.

name: XINFO CONSUMERS
summary: Returns a list of the consumers in a consumer group.

name: XINFO GROUPS
summary: Returns a list of the consumer groups of a stream.

name: XINFO STREAM
summary: Returns information about a stream.

name: XLEN
summary: Return the number of messages in a stream.

name: XPENDING
summary: Returns the information and entries from a stream consumer group's pending entries list.
syntax: XPENDING key group [[IDLE min-idle-time] start end count [consumer]]
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of elements returned

name: XRANGE
summary: Returns the messages from a stream within a range of IDs.
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of elements being returned

name: XREAD
summary: Returns messages from multiple streams with IDs greater than the ones requested. Blocks until a message is available otherwise.
syntax: XREAD [COUNT count] [BLOCK milliseconds] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of elements returned

name: XREADGROUP
summary: Returns new or historical messages from a stream for a consumer in a group. Blocks until a message is available otherwise.
syntax: XREADGROUP GROUP group consumer [COUNT count] [BLOCK milliseconds] [NOACK] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]
complexity: O(M) with M being the number of elements returned

name: XREVRANGE
summary: Returns the messages from a stream within a range of IDs in reverse order.
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of elements returned

name: XSETID
summary: An internal command for replicating stream values.

name: XTRIM
summary: Deletes messages from the beginning of a stream.
complexity: O(N), with N being the number of evicted entries

name: PFADD
summary: Adds elements to a HyperLogLog key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: PFCOUNT
summary: Returns the approximated cardinality of the set(s) observed by the HyperLogLog key(s).
complexity: O(1) with a very small average constant time

name: PFMERGE
summary: Merges one or more HyperLogLog values into a single key.

name: BITCOUNT
summary: Counts the number of set bits (population counting) in a string.

name: BITFIELD
summary: Performs arbitrary bitfield integer operations on strings.
syntax: BITFIELD key [GET encoding offset | [OVERFLOW <WRAP | SAT | FAIL>] <SET encoding offset value | INCRBY encoding offset increment> [GET encoding offset | ...]]

name: BITOP
summary: Performs bitwise operations on multiple strings, and stores the result.
syntax: BITOP <AND | OR | XOR | NOT> destkey key [key ...]

name: BITPOS
summary: Finds the first set (1) or clear (0) bit in a string.

name: GETBIT
summary: Returns a bit value by offset.

name: SETBIT
summary: Sets or clears the bit at offset of the string value. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

name: GEOADD
summary: Adds one or more members to a geospatial index. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
syntax: GEOADD key [NX | XX] [CH] longitude latitude member [longitude latitude member ...]

name: GEODIST
summary: Returns the distance between two members of a geospatial index.
syntax: GEODIST key member1 member2 [M | KM | FT | MI]

name: GEOHASH
summary: Returns members from a geospatial index as geohash strings.

name: GEOPOS
summary: Returns the longitude and latitude of members from a geospatial index.

name: GEOSEARCH
summary: Queries a geospatial index for members inside an area of a box or a circle.
syntax: GEOSEARCH key <FROMMEMBER member | FROMLONLAT longitude latitude> <BYRADIUS radius <M | KM | FT | MI> | BYBOX width height <M | KM | FT | MI>> [ASC | DESC] [COUNT count [ANY]] [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH]

name: GEOSEARCHSTORE
summary: Queries a geospatial index for members inside an area of a box or a circle, optionally stores the result.
syntax: GEOSEARCHSTORE destination source <FROMMEMBER member | FROMLONLAT longitude latitude> <BYRADIUS radius <M | KM | FT | MI> | BYBOX width height <M | KM | FT | MI>> [ASC | DESC] [COUNT count [ANY]] [STOREDIST]

name: PSUBSCRIBE
summary: Listens for messages published to channels that match one or more patterns. Use the Pub/Sub tab.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of patterns to subscribe to

name: PUBLISH
summary: Posts a message to a channel.

name: PUBSUB CHANNELS
summary: Returns the active channels.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of active channels

name: PUBSUB NUMPAT
summary: Returns a count of unique pattern subscriptions.

name: PUBSUB NUMSUB
summary: Returns a count of subscribers to channels.

name: PUBSUB SHARDCHANNELS
summary: Returns the active shard channels.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of active shard channels

name: PUNSUBSCRIBE
summary: Stops listening to messages published to channels that match one or more patterns.

name: SPUBLISH
summary: Post a message to a shard channel.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of clients subscribed to the receiving shard channel

name: SSUBSCRIBE
summary: Listens for messages published to shard channels. Use the Pub/Sub tab.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of shard channels to subscribe to

name: SUBSCRIBE
summary: Listens for messages published to channels. Use the Pub/Sub tab.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of channels to subscribe to

name: UNSUBSCRIBE
summary: Stops listening to messages posted to channels.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of channels to unsubscribe

name: DISCARD
summary: Discards a transaction.
complexity: O(N), when N is the number of queued commands

name: EXEC
summary: Executes all commands in a transaction.
complexity: Depends on commands in the transaction

name: MULTI
summary: Starts a transaction.

name: UNWATCH
summary: Forgets about watched keys of a transaction.

name: WATCH
summary: Monitors changes to keys to determine the execution of a transaction.

name: EVAL
summary: Executes a server-side Lua script.
complexity: Depends on the script that is executed

name: EVAL_RO
summary: Executes a read-only server-side Lua script.
complexity: Depends on the script that is executed

name: EVALSHA
summary: Executes a server-side Lua script by SHA1 digest.
complexity: Depends on the script that is executed

name: EVALSHA_RO
summary: Executes a read-only server-side Lua script by SHA1 digest.
complexity: Depends on the script that is executed

name: FCALL
summary: Invokes a function.
complexity: Depends on the function that is executed

name: FCALL_RO
summary: Invokes a read-only function.
complexity: Depends on the function that is executed

name: FUNCTION DELETE
summary: Deletes a library and its functions.

name: FUNCTION FLUSH
summary: Deletes all libraries and functions.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of functions deleted

name: FUNCTION LIST
summary: Returns information about all libraries.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of functions

name: FUNCTION LOAD
summary: Creates a library.

name: FUNCTION STATS
summary: Returns information about a function during execution.

name: SCRIPT EXISTS
summary: Determines whether server-side Lua scripts exist in the script cache.
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of scripts to check

name: SCRIPT FLUSH
summary: Removes all server-side Lua scripts from the script cache.
complexity: O(N) with N being the number of scripts in cache

name: SCRIPT KILL
summary: Terminates a server-side Lua script during execution.

name: SCRIPT LOAD
summary: Loads a server-side Lua script to the script cache.
complexity: O(N) with N being the length in bytes of the script body

name: AUTH
summary: Authenticates the connection.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of passwords defined for the user

name: CLIENT GETNAME
summary: Returns the name of the connection.

name: CLIENT ID
summary: Returns the unique client ID of the connection.

name: CLIENT INFO
summary: Returns information about the connection.

name: CLIENT KILL
summary: Terminates open connections.
syntax: CLIENT KILL <ip:port | <[ID client-id] | [TYPE <NORMAL | MASTER | SLAVE | REPLICA | PUBSUB>] | [USER username] | [ADDR ip:port] | [LADDR ip:port] | [SKIPME <YES | NO>] | [MAXAGE maxage]> [...]>
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of client connections

name: CLIENT LIST
summary: Lists open connections.
syntax: CLIENT LIST [TYPE <NORMAL | MASTER | REPLICA | PUBSUB>] [ID client-id [client-id ...]]
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of client connections

name: CLIENT NO-EVICT
summary: Sets the client eviction mode of the connection.

name: CLIENT PAUSE
summary: Suspends commands processing.

name: CLIENT SETNAME
summary: Sets the connection name.

name: CLIENT UNPAUSE
summary: Resumes processing commands from paused clients.
complexity: O(N) Where N is the number of paused clients

name: ECHO
summary: Returns the given string.

name: HELLO
summary: Handshakes with the Redis server.

name: PING
summary: Returns the server's liveliness response.

name: QUIT
summary: Closes the connection.

name: RESET
summary: Resets the connection.

name: SELECT
summary: Changes the selected database (tracked by the Workbench/CLI).

name: ACL CAT
summary: Lists the ACL categories, or the commands inside a category.
complexity: O(1) since the categories and commands are a fixed set

name: ACL DELUSER
summary: Deletes ACL users, and terminates their connections.
complexity: O(1) amortized time considering the typical user

name: ACL GETUSER
summary: Lists the ACL rules of a user.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of password, command and pattern rules that the user has

name: ACL LIST
summary: Dumps the effective rules in ACL file format.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of configured users

name: ACL SETUSER
summary: Creates and modifies an ACL user and its rules.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of rules provided

name: ACL USERS
summary: Lists all ACL users.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of configured users

name: ACL WHOAMI
summary: Returns the authenticated username of the current connection.

name: BGREWRITEAOF
summary: Asynchronously rewrites the append-only file to disk.

name: BGSAVE
summary: Asynchronously saves the database(s) to disk.

name: COMMAND COUNT
summary: Returns a count of commands.

name: COMMAND DOCS
summary: Returns documentary information about one, multiple or all commands.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of commands to look up

name: COMMAND INFO
summary: Returns information about one, multiple or all commands.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of commands to look up

name: CONFIG GET
summary: Returns the effective values of configuration parameters.
complexity: O(N) when N is the number of configuration parameters provided

name: CONFIG RESETSTAT
summary: Resets the server's statistics.

name: CONFIG REWRITE
summary: Persists the effective configuration to file.

name: CONFIG SET
summary: Sets configuration parameters in-flight.
complexity: O(N) when N is the number of configuration parameters provided

name: DBSIZE
summary: Returns the number of keys in the database.

name: FLUSHALL
summary: Removes all keys from all databases.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of keys in all databases

name: FLUSHDB
summary: Remove all keys from the current database.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys in the selected database

name: INFO
summary: Returns information and statistics about the server.

name: LASTSAVE
summary: Returns the Unix timestamp of the last successful save to disk.

name: LATENCY DOCTOR
summary: Returns a human-readable latency analysis report.

name: LATENCY HISTORY
summary: Returns timestamp-latency samples for an event.

name: LATENCY LATEST
summary: Returns the latest latency samples for all events.

name: LATENCY RESET
summary: Resets the latency data for one or more events.

name: LOLWUT
summary: Displays computer art and the Redis version.

name: MEMORY DOCTOR
summary: Outputs a memory problems report.

name: MEMORY STATS
summary: Returns details about memory usage.

name: MEMORY USAGE
summary: Estimates the memory usage of a key.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of samples

name: MODULE LIST
summary: Returns all loaded modules.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of loaded modules

name: MONITOR
summary: Listens for all requests received by the server in real-time. Use the MONITOR panel of the Info tab.

name: PSYNC
summary: An internal command used in replication.

name: REPLICAOF
summary: Configures a server as replica of another, or promotes it to a master.

name: ROLE
summary: Returns the replication role.

name: SAVE
summary: Synchronously saves the database(s) to disk.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of keys in all databases

name: SHUTDOWN
summary: Synchronously saves the database(s) to disk and shuts down the Redis server.

name: SLOWLOG GET
summary: Returns the slow log's entries.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of entries returned

name: SLOWLOG LEN
summary: Returns the number of entries in the slow log.

name: SLOWLOG RESET
summary: Clears all entries from the slow log.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of entries in the slowlog

name: SWAPDB
summary: Swaps two Redis databases.
complexity: O(N) where N is the count of clients watching or blocking on keys

name: SYNC
summary: An internal command used in replication.

name: TIME
summary: Returns the server time.

name: CLUSTER COUNTKEYSINSLOT
summary: Returns the number of keys in a hash slot.

name: CLUSTER INFO
summary: Returns information about the state of a node.

name: CLUSTER KEYSLOT
summary: Returns the hash slot for a key.
complexity: O(N) where N is the number of bytes in the key

name: CLUSTER MYID
summary: Returns the ID of a node.

name: CLUSTER NODES
summary: Returns the cluster configuration for a node.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of Cluster nodes

name: CLUSTER SHARDS
summary: Returns the mapping of cluster slots to shards.
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of cluster nodes

name: CLUSTER SLOTS
summary: Returns the mapping of cluster slots to nodes (deprecated: use CLUSTER SHARDS).
complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of Cluster nodes

name: READONLY
summary: Enables read-only queries for a connection to a Redis Cluster replica node.

name: JSON.ARRAPPEND
summary: Append one or more JSON values into the array at path after the last element in it.
complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.ARRINDEX
summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a JSON scalar value in the array at path.
complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.ARRLEN
summary: Returns the length of the array at path.
complexity: O(1) where path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.CLEAR
summary: Clears all values from an array or an object and sets numeric values to 0.
complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.DEL
summary: Deletes a value.
complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.GET
summary: Gets the value at one or more paths in JSON serialized form.
complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.MGET
summary: Returns the values at a path from one or more keys.
complexity: O(M*N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.NUMINCRBY
summary: Increments the numeric value at path by a value.
complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.OBJKEYS
summary: Returns the JSON keys of the object at path.
complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.SET
summary: Sets or updates the JSON value at a path.
complexity: O(M+N) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.STRLEN
summary: Returns the length of the JSON String at path in key.
complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: JSON.TYPE
summary: Returns the type of the JSON value at path.
complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value

name: FT._LIST
summary: Returns a list of all existing indexes.

name: FT.AGGREGATE
summary: Run a search query on an index and perform aggregate transformations on the results.
syntax: FT.AGGREGATE index query [VERBATIM] [LOAD count field [field ...]] [GROUPBY nargs property [property ...] [REDUCE function nargs arg [arg ...]]] [SORTBY nargs [property <ASC | DESC> ...] [MAX num]] [APPLY expression AS name] [LIMIT offset num] [FILTER filter] [PARAMS nargs name value [name value ...]] [DIALECT dialect]

name: FT.CREATE
summary: Creates an index with the given spec.
syntax: FT.CREATE index [ON <HASH | JSON>] [PREFIX count prefix [prefix ...]] [FILTER filter] [LANGUAGE default_lang] [SCORE default_score] [STOPWORDS count [stopword ...]] SCHEMA field_name [AS alias] <TEXT | TAG | NUMERIC | GEO | VECTOR> [SORTABLE] [NOINDEX] [field_name ...]
complexity: O(K) at creation where K is the number of fields

name: FT.DROPINDEX
summary: Deletes the index.
complexity: O(1) or O(N) if documents are deleted

name: FT.EXPLAIN
summary: Returns the execution plan for a complex query.

name: FT.INFO
summary: Returns information and statistics on the index.

name: FT.SEARCH
summary: Searches the index with a textual query, returning either documents or just ids.
syntax: FT.SEARCH index query [NOCONTENT] [VERBATIM] [WITHSCORES] [FILTER numeric_field min max] [RETURN count identifier [AS property] ...] [SORTBY sortby [ASC | DESC]] [LIMIT offset num] [PARAMS nargs name value [name value ...]] [DIALECT dialect]

name: TS.ADD
summary: Append a sample to a time series.
syntax: TS.ADD key timestamp value [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [ENCODING <COMPRESSED | UNCOMPRESSED>] [CHUNK_SIZE size] [ON_DUPLICATE policy] [LABELS label value ...]
complexity: O(M) when M is the amount of compaction rules or O(1) with no compaction

name: TS.CREATE
summary: Create a new time series.
syntax: TS.CREATE key [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [ENCODING <COMPRESSED | UNCOMPRESSED>] [CHUNK_SIZE size] [DUPLICATE_POLICY policy] [LABELS label value ...]

name: TS.GET
summary: Get the sample with the highest timestamp from a given time series.

name: TS.INFO
summary: Returns information and statistics for a time series.

name: TS.RANGE
summary: Query a range in forward direction.
syntax: TS.RANGE key fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST] [FILTER_BY_TS ts ...] [FILTER_BY_VALUE min max] [COUNT count] [AGGREGATION aggregator bucketDuration]
